report:
Reviewed the complete rendering claim and all five ordinary implementation associations and nine ordinary tests; no TODO/N/A entries exist. Separate outputs: CompileTest stores observations, diagnostics and optional queries as independent Option<expect_test::Expect> fields, compile_test! routes each expression to its setter, and run invokes Expect::assert_eq independently only after prepare succeeds. This delegates comparison and UPDATE_EXPECT updates to expect-test, preserving the blessing barrier. The unresolved-path test requests all three channels, asserts the exact unresolved observation, a real diagnostic and nonempty JSON trace, and rejects contamination across channels; invalid_source_reaches_sage and tuples_and_multiline_descriptions exercise actual expect! assertions. Tests that call prepare with empty Expect values inspect returned output and do not themselves verify snapshot comparison.

Deterministic types and expression order: observe::collect sorts target file/line keys and type rows by file/end/reverse-start; FrozenType captures semantic data, distinguishes qualified local names and recursively formats tuples, refs, arrays, functions, projections and opaque aliases without IDs. The tuple test asserts children before their parent and a complete multiline tuple; distinct_same_named_types_keep_their_identity asserts a::Value and b::Value remain distinct. compact walks Rust syntax tokens, skips annotation line comments, emits one separator only for gaps, keeps string/raw-string/character literals as indivisible content, and escapes backslash before backtick, LF and CR. The compact unit test directly asserts internal literal double spaces/backslash retention, raw literal embedded LF escaping, annotation omission and inter-token whitespace normalization; tuple snapshots verify this end to end. Delimiter/CR branches are straightforward inspected replacements sharing that escape path.

Diagnostic fidelity: the harness uses DiagnosticSnapshot::render, not the older live Diagnostic::render. Snapshot capture freezes message, severity, complete source text, labels/styles, and recursively notes. Rendering visits primary then labeled sources in encountered order, attaches primary/context labels and recursively appends notes; collect maps diagnostics in existing vector order and joins without sorting or deduplication. labels_and_notes_do_not_supply_matching_locations asserts related label and nested warning remain rendered; invalid_source_reaches_sage compares the entire source excerpt, annotation comment, expected/found labels and meaningful type error. matching_preserves_identical_diagnostics_and_output_order asserts matching preserves an ordered vector including duplicate diagnostics. evaluated_source_retains_blank_lines_indentation_and_unicode checks original indentation, Unicode source and annotation text.

Paths and semantic preservation: source::normalize_path canonicalizes only logical path components. Observation paths and diagnostic prefix_paths use fixture-relative src paths, including recursively nested notes/labels, without replacing messages or source. Snapshot expectations assert src/lib.rs. cold_queries_are_stable_across_isolated_projects asserts equal query outputs from different temporary projects and absence of /tmp/ and internal Id text. The unresolved-path test rejects unmarked errors and preserves <unresolved> with marked errors; collect rejects incomplete typed observations instead of inventing display values, and FrozenType preserves explicit error types. Thus normalization does not suppress unexpected diagnostics or semantic distinctions. Captured annotations::tree is the Rust parser helper used for token boundaries; other called semantic compiler facilities are not re-reviewed as part of presentation. All relevant presentation behavior is in the five associated files.

Executed cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-test-harness compact_descriptions_preserve_token_and_literal_contents --lib passed (1); cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test compile_tests passed (14); cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib compile:: -- --test-threads=4 passed (33). cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test review_semantics distinct_same_named_types_keep_their_identity passed (1). Build/delegated quality checks are coordinated centrally. No production behavior changed; added associations connect already substantive evidence to this claim.
